waterfront_evidence: DNR Zippel Bay campground map: Ridge/Birch/Lady's Slipper campgrounds all ~0.5-0.8mi inland (S) of Zippel Bay/Lake of the Woods; beach/marina separate at the bay -> not waterfront. ReserveMN facilities 757, 1098, 1099 search/details for all 41 sites (read 2026-11-11): no 'Water Front' amenity; 'Lake/River/Creek' .25 mile (Lady's Slipper), 1.4 and 1.8 miles (Birch, Ridge).
inclusion_evidence: MN DNR Zippel Bay (spk00284) + park map spk00284.pdf + ReserveMN placeid 135 (facilities 757 Lady's Slipper, 1098 Birch, 1099 Ridge; read 2026-11-11): 41 web-bookable back-in drive-in sites in three wooded loops on one campground road, $24, pads 20-40 ft (most 24 ft or more), 2027 season 04-16..11-03 -> real (rustic) RV campground a 23-ft rig fits.
note: Rustic sites in three wooded campgrounds, Ridge, Birch and Lady's Slipper, near Zippel Bay on Lake of the Woods, with over two miles of sand beach, a marina and a fishing pier. Lady's Slipper is the closest to the beach (about a quarter mile); Anglers, the park's fourth campground, about 1.6 km west, has its own entry. Showers and the dump station are by the ranger station. --Claude

sites.note: 41 back-in sites: Birch 16, Ridge 14, Lady's Slipper 11. ReserveMN pads run 20-40 ft; large fifth wheels and RVs are advised not to go past Ridge Campground (narrow roads, no turnarounds, small sites).

fees.note: ReserveMN: $24 a night for every one of the 41 sites, June 2027 nights. Read 2026-11-11.
